Draw every spall fragment, also the ones.en-US: Draw every spall fragment, also the ones that hit nothing (faint). Off: only the ones that hit something, like War Thunder.

Rounds smaller than this (autocannons) g.zh-CN: 小于此口径的弹药（机炮）只有短回放；同一车辆上的更多命中会并入正在播放的回放。

Damage on the real vehicles in the game.en-US: Damage on the real vehicles in the game world: holes, petals, scorch marks, sparks and shrapnel. Looks only, no effect on the game.
